scope_note: Reference taxonomy of 20 research areas, not an exhaustive count of Xbox Series APIs, features, or work remaining in any one project.

features.title: Executable loader
features.description: Load and map console executables and modules

features.title: Kernel services
features.description: Kernel calls, native APIs and exception handling

features.title: Memory management
features.description: Address spaces, virtual memory, allocation and mapping

features.title: Threads and scheduling
features.description: Threads, scheduling and fibers

features.title: Synchronization
features.description: Locks, waits, semaphores and events

features.title: File system
features.description: Virtual file system, mounts and file I/O

features.title: GDK / GameCore
features.description: Xbox GDK and GameCore runtime services

features.title: Users and accounts
features.description: Identity, profile and user services

features.title: Input
features.description: Gamepad, controllers and other input

features.title: Audio
features.description: XAudio and audio playback pipelines

features.title: Networking
features.description: Socket, multiplayer and networking support

features.title: Saved data
features.description: Save games, storage and persistence

features.title: D3D12 interface
features.description: D3D12 or console graphics API translation

features.title: Shader translation
features.description: Shader formats, IR and translation

features.title: Textures and resources
features.description: GPU resources, tiled textures and memory layouts

features.title: GPU commands and sync
features.description: Command buffers, GPU fences and synchronization

features.title: Media decoding
features.description: Video and media codecs

features.title: Static recompilation
features.description: Binary translation, recompilation and disassembly

features.title: Compatibility tests
features.description: Conformance tests and repeatable compatibility test harnesses

features.title: Commercial game boot
features.description: Observed boot and gameplay milestones, requires independent evidence
